records.body:
<!-- agent-braid-task-id: SPEC-045/T001 -->

## Task

Record the integrated synthetic engineering boundary and ownership. Dependencies: none. Targets: forecast modules, tests and feature-local evidence. Verification: record the owner scope, technical/model boundary review, memory/stdio/deadline contract and module ownership; behavior is verified by later tasks. This does not approve sources or model artifacts. Command: `.venv-speckit/bin/python -m unittest discover -s tests -p "test_forecast*.py" -v`. Planned evidence: `evidence/engineering.json`; obtained evidence: historical engineering/model/installed evidence is mapped in `convergence-2026-10-14.md` and the additive `evidence/reconciliation-acceptance.json`; actual-model/cost and tracking obligations retain their own gates.
